primaryRootCause.evidenceBasis: The recovery owner emits FUNCTIONAL_DEFECT only when the callable response is non-successful or does not return result.ok=true.
primaryRootCause.reasonExactStatusUnavailable: The local sanitized recovery evidence was not committed after the scope stage was skipped.
primaryRootCause.strongestSourceBasedContractRisk: The census actor selector does not prove the full tenantId/status/activeRole authorization contract required by the callable before selecting the privileged actor.

secondaryRootCause.owner: .github/workflows/orbit360-auth-access-recovery-lab-v3-20260805.yml::Persistir evidencia y cierre sin tocar request
secondaryRootCause.mechanism: The workflow unconditionally added ORBIT360_SCOPE_EVIDENCE even though the scope step is skipped when recovery fails. git add aborted and prevented the local failure evidence and lifecycle closure from reaching the branch.

sourceOnlySolutions: Validate the administrative actor against the same tenantId, active status, assigned activeRole and role/permission contract used by the callable before invocation.
Persist callable response status and sanitized detail codes in recovery evidence and final evidence.
Build the git add list conditionally from files that actually exist.
Treat scope and rollback evidence as optional when their stages were not reached.
Never render a missing integrity postverify as evidence that CRM changed.
